title: Elf Bar 600 Watermelon Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Compatible with the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pods offer an easy and sustainable way to enjoy Elf Bar’s standout flavours. Each 2ml prefilled pod delivers up to 600 puffs, depending on personal usage, and contains 20mg nic salt e-liquid for a smooth, satisfying draw and rapid nicotine relief. Watermelon Flavour: A refreshingly crisp and juicy watermelon flavour that captures the natural sweetness of ripe melon with a subtly cool exhale. Light yet satisfying, this is a great option for those who enjoy mellow, fruit-forward vapes. Swapping pods is quick and effortless—just click a fresh one into place and vape. Whether you're moving away from disposables or looking for a hassle-free way to experience Elf Bar’s premium flavours, these prefilled pods provide a consistently satisfying vape.
